candidate.title: Embed loading page auto-reloads every 30s, amplifying unauthenticated request/job flooding risk
reports: unauthenticated embed endpoint enqueues a background job per request with no throttle or input cap — the referer check is trivially forged, there is no per-ip/route rate limit, no dedup, and no length limit on the embedurl param (job args go straight into redis), so combined with the 30s reload loop in loading.html.erb this is a sidekiq/redis flooding vector
